meta.name: Munchkin's Hollow Quill Station
meta.description: An utterly absurd, yet undeniably effective architectural fixture crafted by The Paradox Symposium of St. Munchkin. Built from plumb hollow quill ore and anchored by an iron stormbreaker charm, placing this in your house brilliantly manipulates subterranean bureaucracy. By exploiting a loophole in the Deep-Bore Horologist's zoning laws, it projects a HUD chalk outline whenever a new layer is revealed, mildly enhancing your luck when well-rested.
meta.author: jules
